knock-balls.title: Knock Balls - Smash & Score!
knock-balls.slogan: Smash structures, save balls, and level up!
knock-balls.description: Experience the thrill of Knock Balls, where you throw balls at structures to make them collapse. Be strategic and save balls to double your score in the next level. With easy-to-learn controls, stunning visuals, and addictive gameplay, Knock Balls offers endless fun. Play now and see how high you can score!

HomeIframe.title: Knock Balls™
HomeIframe.description: Throw balls at structures to make them collapse but be careful not to exceed the allowed limit! Each saved ball will count double at the next level, take advantage of it to apply you! One-tap easy-to-learn controls with stunning visual effects and addictive gameplay mechanics.
